# 功能法案

## capabilityDomain: ai-input-gateway

### [LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-001-V1] APEX-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-001-V1

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "src/capabilities/ai-input-gateway/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "ai-input-gateway",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "static.contract",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：business plugins importing provider adapters, provider SDKs, provider DOM, browser selectors, coordinates, tab ids, or browser commands",
    "不得发生：AI Input Gateway making business judgments or validating domain output meaning",
    "不得发生：maxInputChars, a prompt character/byte/token ceiling, a prompt budget increase, prompt splitting, or any local prompt-capacity rejection before the real provider window",
    "不得发生：a second provider transport owner, compatibility transport wrapper, provider-specific business API, parallel GPT page-control chain, or title-housekeeping worker",
    "不得发生：a production profile default, legacy caller normalization, compatibility profile reader, or proof minted for a request that did not carry the canonical profile"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-001-V1",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须保持以下不变量：AI Input Gateway is the single provider-transport owner and must preserve a provider-agnostic public request contract.",
  "supersedesLawId": null,
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

### [LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-002-V1] APEX-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-002-V1

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "src/capabilities/ai-input-gateway/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "ai-input-gateway",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：reading cookies, browser storage, passwords, tokens, or hidden credentials",
    "不得发生：automatic login, CAPTCHA bypass, account rotation, security-barrier bypass, or unbounded retry",
    "不得发生：patrol, submission or another task reacquiring the provider target while any plugin takeover owner remains active",
    "不得发生：parallel or detached BrowserTargetLease commands within one provider page operation",
    "不得发生：a later page-action proof resolving earlier unrelated mutations, a second mutation before the prior one is resolved, substring identity for exact semantic choices, or fixed sleep used as a production transition",
    "不得发生：downgrading or erasing a completely captured provider response because later title, artifact or cleanup work failed",
    "不得发生：using application activation, whichever Chrome window is foreground, accessibility window ordering, or a second physical provider tab as page identity"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-002-V1",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须保持以下不变量：Web-chat provider work must use an operator-authorized authenticated Browser authority lease and exact target/document lease, fail closed on provider security barriers, and preserve exact raw response truth.",
  "supersedesLawId": null,
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

### [LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-003-V1] APEX-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-003-V1

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "src/capabilities/ai-input-gateway/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "ai-input-gateway",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "static.contract",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：transport kind, provider selector, DOM selector, coordinate, tab id, picker instruction, or fallback policy in the public request",
    "不得发生：switching transport after an attachment attempt starts",
    "不得发生：retrying the same file through clipboard, native picker, focus lease, OS accessibility action or any second upload path",
    "不得发生：a detached provider-input-preflight caller, HTTP route, temporary chat, capacity waiter, base64 file envelope, upload-clear-reupload sequence, or any second attachment action graph",
    "不得发生：an HTTP request-body or per-file byte ceiling used to admit governed provider files",
    "不得发生：accepting a lower-bound attachment count or a page URL, file input, attachment name or attachment count that is not exact",
    "不得发生：a local file byte ceiling, token estimate, token budget, threshold increase or file splitting rule that blocks an otherwise governed file before the real provider window decides whether it can accept it"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-003-V1",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须保持以下不变量：attach-approved-web-chat-files-once is the only web-chat attachment child and selects one fixed internal transport without caller choice or same-attempt fallback.",
  "supersedesLawId": null,
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

### [LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-005-V4] APEX-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-005-V4

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "src/capabilities/ai-input-gateway/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "ai-input-gateway",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "static.contract",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：a global browser lease held from provider open through response capture",
    "不得发生：a second physical ChatGPT tab, per-task tab lease or provider-tab pool",
    "不得发生：refreshing/reloading ChatGPT after rate-limit acknowledgement or as a no-result recovery action",
    "不得发生：clearing an unmarked or ambiguously owned composer, or treating a root draft as owned without exact marker evidence",
    "不得发生：routing, retrying, deduplicating, continuing, forking or recovering a task from provider title text",
    "不得发生：binding or routing a transient /c/WEB: URL as a canonical conversation",
    "不得发生：same-origin tab fallback, active/front/first tab selection, foreground-window dependence or offscreen blind click",
    "不得发生：in-memory-only submission priority, unordered submission or patrol races, preserving a dead-process waiter without a current eligible Cloud grant, releasing a live current-grant submission ticket before checkpoint o",
    "不得发生：fixed reasoning-slider indexes, coordinate-to-reasoning arithmetic, model fallback, reasoning downgrade, caller split model/reasoning controls after production admission, or profile proof that does not match the has",
    "不得发生：caller-supplied chat title, title text derived from prompt/user/report content, machine title used as primary identity, title search used as final route proof, rename debt worker, periodic title housekeeping or a se",
    "不得发生：publishing a title-managed production GPT checkpoint before exact profile/title proof exists",
    "不得发生：detaching provider post-processing as fire-and-forget work after checkpoint publication",
    "不得发生：using stale BrowserDocumentRef coordinates after navigation or DOM document replacement",
    "不得发生：page-global last-response extraction, legacy turn selectors, screenshot-as-output, or generated-image selector fallbacks",
    "不得发生：a failed execution state without durable phase/classification/recoverability/reason evidence",
    "不得发生：reopening any legacy technical failure that has any submission, upload, page-action, UNKNOWN mutation, checkpoint or output proof"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-005-V4",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须保持以下不变量：GPT Web uses one Session Controller to bind task identity, semantic execution profile, exact conversation topology, bounded page actions and compulsory privacy-safe title finalization without making titles a routing identity.",
  "supersedesLawId": "LAW-AI-INPUT-GATEWAY-005-V3",
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

## capabilityDomain: amazon-invoice-upload

### [LAW-AMAZON-INVOICE-UPLOAD-001-V2] APEX-AMAZON-INVOICE-UPLOAD-001-V2

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "src/plugins/amazon-invoice-upload/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "amazon-invoice-upload",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "exam.golden",
    "dynamic.browser"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：BrowserController, CWS, page relay, external debugging port, native messaging, legacy open/evaluate/getLeaseState API, BrowserTargetSession or DOM-automation compatibility bridge",
    "不得发生：fallback upload/download browser path, shadow queue, second invoice plugin, second mediator, second evidence store or second runtime-log chain",
    "不得发生：calling Amazon Seller Central or recording upload/download success while terminal Browser Authority admission is absent",
    "不得发生：mapping browser authority absence to order_not_found, upload_success or download completion",
    "不得发生：future or conditional Invoice Browser capability text inside active authority"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-AMAZON-INVOICE-UPLOAD-001-V2",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须保持以下不变量：Amazon invoice upload remains one plugin owner and always fails closed at the terminal Browser Authority gate because the active site policy authorizes no Invoice write action.",
  "supersedesLawId": "LAW-AMAZON-INVOICE-UPLOAD-001-V1",
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

## capabilityDomain: app-shell-ui

  "tier": "P0"
}

## capabilityDomain: xuanxue-ai-production

### [LAW-XUANXUE-AI-PRODUCTION-001-V6] APEX-XUANXUE-AI-PRODUCTION-001-V6

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "src/plugins/xuanxue-ai-production/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "xuanxue-ai-production",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "static.contract",
    "exam.golden",
    "dynamic.browser",
    "dynamic.provider"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：V5 active reader writer validator route config package entry or process",
    "不得发生：Browser Workspace Authority Target Document selector command mutation journal Browser command TTL or wall-clock Workspace TTL in the Cloud contract",
    "不得发生：device credential used for claim renew checkpoint terminal or material access",
    "不得发生：session credential persisted logged displayed or given to Extension",
    "不得发生：two claim-eligible sessions for one device",
    "不得发生：stale attestation or absent Browser capability receiving browser-required lease",
    "不得发生：HTTP 200 empty jobs or partial ready presented as end-to-end readiness",
    "不得发生：xuanxue external HMAC LNA localhost business ingress or Cloud callback",
    "不得发生：second worker mediator scheduler queue ledger Browser Provider contract owner or transport",
    "不得发生：service class recovery partition registration order or in-memory ordering bypassing globally oldest eligible work",
    "不得发生：automatic replay of UNKNOWN or replacement job prompt for a recoverable original",
    "不得发生：alias default normalization compatibility fallback shadow bridge dual reader or dual writer",
    "不得发生：stale foreign or caller-minted Chrome Provider candidate receipt"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-XUANXUE-AI-PRODUCTION-001-V6",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须只由 xuanxue-ai-production-v6 经 session-bound Cloud Worker→Mediator→Plugin 唯一链交付完整网站订单；每设备只允许一个 claim-eligible worker session，并以签名 attestation、幂等 claim、十个业务席位、一个 Browser mutation lane、durable outbox 与 first-terminal CAS 保持原始业务身份。",
  "supersedesLawId": "LAW-XUANXUE-AI-PRODUCTION-001-V5",
  "tier": "P0"
}
```
